```{r Standard Setup}
ps <- output$ps # phyloseq object
taxa_order <- output$taxa_order # ASV plot order
samdf <- output$samdf # sample information
samdf$Sample <- rownames(samdf)

total_reads <- as.data.frame(sample_sums(ps)) # get total number of reads

# Add read counts and sample info

  left_join(total_reads, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(total_reads = ifelse(is.na(total_reads), 0, total_reads)) %>%
  left_join(samples, by = "Sample_ID")

# update samdf of phyloseq
rownames(samdf) <- sub('sample_', '', samdf$Sample) # change row names to be the sequencing name, remove "sample_"
samdf <- samdf %>%
  select(-Sample) 
sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(samdf)

#######################################
# Variables to change
#######################################

set_ordered_factors <- function(df2plot) {
  # Set default ordered factors in dataframe
  df2plot <- df2plot %>%
      mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = c("NA", "Saliva", "R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Sample_origin2 = factor(Sample_origin2, levels = c("Saliva", "Cap", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Sample_origin = factor(Sample_origin, levels = c("Saliva", "Cap0", "Cap1", "Cap2", "Cap3", "Cap4", "Cap5", "Cap6", "Cap7", "Cap8", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Collection_day = factor(Collection_day, levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "unk"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Ingestion_day = factor(Ingestion_day, levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "unk"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Tip_color = factor(Tip_color, levels = c("White", "Blue", "NA"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Diet_ingestion = factor(Diet_ingestion, levels = c("Regular1", "Regular2", "Same_keto", "Regular4", "Regular5_1", "Fasting", "Regular5_2", "Regular6", "Regular7", "Regular8", "Regular9", "Regular10", "Regular11", "Regular12", "Regular13", "Regular14", "Regular15", "Regular16", "Unknown", "NA"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Diet_collection = factor(Diet_collection, levels = c("Regular1", "Regular2", "Same_keto", "Regular4", "Regular5_1", "Fasting", "Regular5_2", "Regular6", "Regular7", "Regular8", "Regular9", "Regular10", "Regular11", "Regular12", "Regular13", "Regular14", "Regular15", "Regular16", "Unknown", "NA"), ordered = TRUE))
  df2plot$total_reads <- factor(df2plot$total_reads)
  return(df2plot)
}
```

#######################################

```{r Sequencer stats}
num_zeros <- sum(samdf$total_reads == 0)
num_samples <- sum(samdf$total_reads >= 0)

g <- ggplot(samdf, aes(x = log10(total_reads), fill = Region)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
  scale_x_continuous("log10(reads)", limits = c(0, NA), breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)) +
  labs(x = "log10(reads)", y = "Counts", subtitle = paste0(num_zeros, " of ", num_samples, " samples have 0 reads.")) + 
  facet_grid(rows = vars(group)) +
  ggtitle("Read distribution") +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),  # Legend text size
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Couple-Sequencer/Read-counts-region.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 4, height = 4)

```

```{r Composition - by sample_origin}

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(group == "LONGIT"
                                 & Region == "Saliva")

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
    filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
  
ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize
  
df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors
  
family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors

for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_no)) {
  
    if (length(unique(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_no == sid) %>% pull(Sample_ID))) == 0) {
      next
    }
  
    g <- ggplot(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_no == sid), aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
         geom_bar(aes(x = total_reads), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
         scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
         scale_x_discrete(labels = red_if_small_discrete) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
         facet_nested(cols = vars(Collection_date, Collection_time, Sample_origin2), scales = "free", space = "free") +
         theme_custom_comp() +
         theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
        
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-composition-0p01/Saliva-collection/Composition-saliva-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 0.5*length(unique(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_no == sid) %>% pull(Sample_ID))) + 1, height = 4)
}

g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
     geom_bar(aes(x = 1), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
     scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
     theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 5),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm")) +
     guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = FALSE)) + # Legend columns, fill legend items by column

legend <- get_legend(g)
```

```{r Composition - by kit}

    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize
  
df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors

family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors

for (kit in unique(kits$Kit_ID)) {
  
  if (is.na(kit) | kit %in% c("LS061")) {
    next
  }
  
  saliva_ID <- kits$Saliva[kits$Kit_ID == kit]
  stool_ID <- kits$Stool[kits$Kit_ID == kit]
  
  kit2plot <- df2plot %>% filter((Sample_origin2 == "Cap" & Kit_ID == kit) |

         geom_bar(aes(x = interaction(total_reads, Region)), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
         scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +

         scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
         facet_nested(cols = vars(Subject_no, Collection_date_reformat, Collection_time, Sample_origin2), scales = "free", space = "free") +
         theme_custom_text() +
         theme_custom_comp() +  
         theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 6))

   ggsave(paste0(directory, "Couple-composition-0p01/Kit-collection/" , subject_no , "/Composition-", kit, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 0.5*length(unique(kit2plot %>% pull(Sample_ID))) + 1, height = 4)
}
```

```{r Composition - capscan heirarchical clustering}

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(group == "LONGIT"
                                 & Subject_no != "Subj3"
                                 & Sample_origin2 == "Cap"
                                 & total_reads > 10000)

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
    filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)

ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize

df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors

####

for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {

    dist_mat <- phyloseq::distance(ps2plot, method = d_metric)
    hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "average")
    sample_order <- hc$labels[hc$order]
    
    df2plot$Sample <- factor(df2plot$Sample, levels = sample_order)
      
    family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors
    
    g_comp <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) +
      geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1, width = 1) +
      #scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
      theme_custom_comp() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
      )
    
    # Create annotation data for each sample
    annotation_data <- df2plot %>%
      select(Sample, Subject_no, Region, Diet_ingestion, Diet_collection) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(Subject_no, Region, Diet_ingestion, Diet_collection), 
                   names_to = "Annotation", 
                   values_to = "Value") %>%
      mutate(Annotation = factor(Annotation, levels = c("Subject_no", "Region", "Diet_ingestion", "Diet_collection")))
    
    family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors
    
    g_comp <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) +
      geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1, width = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
      theme_custom_comp() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
      )
    
    #colors_prediction = c("SI_light" = "#F8766D", "SI" = "#A3A500", "SI_dark" = "#00BF7D", "AC" = "#00B0F6", "NA" = "#E76BF3")
    colors_subject <- setNames(hue_pal()(4), unique(samdf$Subject_no))
    
    # Create annotation plot
    g_annot <- ggplot(annotation_data, aes(x = Sample, y = Annotation, fill = Value)) +
      geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors_subject, colors_origin, colors_diet)) +  # Combine your color palettes
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "null"
      )
    
    g_combined <- g_comp / g_annot + plot_layout(heights = c(4, 0.5))
    
    g_combined
    
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-composition-0p01/Composition-all-Capscan-clustered-", d_metric, ".pdf"), plot = g_combined, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 5)
}
```

```{r ASV heatmap - by sample_origin}
for (sid in c("Subj1", "Subj2")) {

      filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)

}
```

```{r Alpha diversity}
alpha_df <- estimate_richness(ps %>% subset_samples(group == "LONGIT"),
                              measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson"))
rownames(alpha_df) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(alpha_df))
alpha_df$sample <- substr(rownames(alpha_df), 2, nchar(rownames(alpha_df)))

df2plot <- samdf %>%
  filter(group == "LONGIT") %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(alpha_df, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(Shannon = replace_na(Shannon, 0)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample") 

df2plot <- df2plot %>% filter(total_reads > 10000)

df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot)

shannon_summary <- df2plot %>%
  group_by(Sample_origin3) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_shannon = mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_shannon = sd(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_shannon = min(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_shannon = max(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    range = paste0(round(min(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " - ", 
                   round(max(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shannon_means <- df2plot %>%
  group_by(Sample_origin2) %>%
  summarise(mean_shannon = mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = Shannon, fill = Region)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(data = shannon_means, aes(xintercept = mean_shannon), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = shannon_means, 
            aes(x = mean_shannon, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Avg: %.2f", mean_shannon)),
            vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, color = "red", size = 2,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
  scale_x_continuous("Shannon diversity", limits = c(0, NA), breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Sample_origin2)) +
  labs(x = "Shannon diversity", y = "Counts") +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 5),  # Legend text size
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"))
```

#######################################
# PCoA analyses 10,000 read cutoff

```{r PCoA - by sample origin}

set.seed(100) # Consistent pcoa

for (region in c("Saliva", "Cap", "Stool")) {
    
    ps2ordinate <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin2 == region 
                                         & group == "LONGIT"
                                         & Subject_no != "Subj3"
                                         & total_reads > 10000) # Choose which samples you want to ordinate
    otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)
    
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ] # Remove rows with all zeros (empty OTU rows)
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ] # Remove OTUs present in < 3 samples
    
    retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)
    
    # Subset all components accordingly
    ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
                               sample_data(ps),
                               tax_table(ps)[retained_otus, ],
                               phy_tree(ps))
    
    ps_clean <- prune_taxa(retained_otus, ps_clean)
    
    for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {
    
      pcoa_weighted <- ordinate(ps_clean, method = "MDS", distance = d_metric)
      ordination_data <- merge(pcoa_weighted$vectors, samdf, by = "row.names")
      var_exp <- get_evals(pcoa_weighted)$variance_exp # variances
  
      x_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.1)
      y_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.2)
      aspect_ratio <- diff(x_range) / diff(y_range)
      
      ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data) # set ordered factors
      
      lines_df <- ordination_data %>%
        filter(Region %in% region_order) %>%
        mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = region_order)) %>%
        arrange(Sample_ID, Region)  # Ensures correct order within Kit_ID
      
      colors2plot <- colors_diet
      
      # if (region == "Saliva") {
      #   colors2plot <- saliva_colors
      # } 
      # 
      # if (region == "Stool") {
      #   colors2plot <- stool_colors
      # }
      # 
      # if (region == "Cap") {
      #   colors2plot <- capscan_colors
      # } 
      # 
      g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Diet_collection, shape = Region)) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot)

           if (region == "Cap") {
              g <- g +
                geom_path(data = lines_df, aes(group = Subject_no), color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.6, lineend = "round")
            }

      g <- g +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
           guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
           facet_wrap(~Subject_no, ncol = 5) +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(3, 3, 3, 3), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(3, 3, 3, 3), "cm"),
                           TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes

      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA/", region, "/PCoA-", d_metric, "-", region, "-sample-origin.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 7)
      
      g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Subject_no, shape = Region)) +
           stat_ellipse(aes(color = Subject_no), type = "norm", level = 0.68, # 1 std dev
               geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.1, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Add ellipses
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
           guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"),
                           TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes

      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA/", region, "/Subject_no/PCoA-", d_metric, "-", region, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 7)
    
      # if (region == "Cap") {
      # g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Prediction)) +
      #      stat_ellipse(aes(color = Prediction), type = "norm", level = 0.68, # 1 std dev
      #          geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.1, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Add ellipses
      #      geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black", shape = 21) +
      #      #scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
      #      guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
      #      #facet_grid(vars(Prediction)) +
      #      force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"),
      #                      cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"),
      #                      TRUE) +
      #      labs(title = d_metric,
      #           x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
      #           y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
      #      coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes
      # 
      # ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA/", region, "/SI-prediction/PCoA-", d_metric, "-", region, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 7)
```

```{r PCoA - all samples}
      x_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.1)
      y_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.2)
      aspect_ratio <- diff(x_range) / diff(y_range)
      
      ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data) # set ordered factors
      
      lines_df <- ordination_data %>%
        filter(Region %in% region_order) %>%
        mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = region_order)) %>%
        arrange(Kit_ID, Region)  # Ensures correct order within Kit_ID
      
      colors2plot <- colors_origin
      
       g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Region, shape = Region)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
           guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                           cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                           TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio) + # Force square axes
          theme(legend.position = "null")
      
      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA/All/PCoA-", d_metric, "-all.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 3, height = 3)
      
      g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Region, shape = Region)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           facet_grid(cols = vars(Subject_no)) +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
           guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                           cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                           TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio) + # Force square axes
          theme(legend.position = "null")
      
      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA/All/Subject_no/PCoA-", d_metric, "-all.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 3)
    
}
```

#######################################
# Distances between paired samples
#######################################

```{r Distances between paired capscan and stool}

ps_filtered <- ps %>%
  subset_samples(total_reads > 10000
                 & group == "LONGIT"
                 & Subject_no != "Subj3"
                 & Sample_origin2 %in% c("Cap", "Stool"))

paired_distances <- list()

for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {
  
  # Calculate distance matrix
  dist_mat <- distance(ps_filtered, method = d_metric)
  dist_df <- as.matrix(dist_mat)
  
  # Get sample metadata
  sample_info <- sample_data(ps_filtered) %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Sample")
  
  # Find paired samples (same Kit_ID, different Sample_origin2)
  capscan_samples <- sample_info %>% filter(Sample_origin2 == "Cap")
  stool_samples <- sample_info %>% filter(Sample_origin2 == "Stool")
  
  # Match by Kit_ID
  paired_results <- capscan_samples %>%
    inner_join(stool_samples, by = "Kit_ID", suffix = c("_Capscan", "_Stool")) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      distance = dist_df[Sample_Capscan, Sample_Stool],
      metric = d_metric
    ) %>%
    select(Kit_ID, Subject_ID_Capscan, Sample_Capscan, Region_Capscan, Sample_Stool, distance, metric, )
  
  paired_distances[[d_metric]] <- paired_results
}

# Combine all results
all_paired_distances <- bind_rows(paired_distances)

g <- ggplot(all_paired_distances, aes(x = Region_Capscan, y = distance, fill = Region_Capscan)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 1, linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(metric)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 1, size = 0.1) +
    labs(title = "Capscan vs Stool Distances by Metric",
         x = "Distance Metric",
         y = "Distance") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA/Distances-betw-cap-stool-region.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 3, height = 5)

summary_stats <- all_paired_distances %>%
  group_by(metric, Region_Capscan) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dist = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dist = sd(distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    summary = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f (n=%d)", 
                     mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE), 
                     sd(distance, na.rm = TRUE), 
                     n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

#######################################
# Total number of ASVs, 10000 read cutoff
#######################################

```{r Total ASVs}

cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.001, 0.0001)
nonzero_per_sample <- NULL

for (cutoff in cutoffs) {

  ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(total_reads > 10000)
  
  taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
        filter(Abundance > cutoff)
      
  ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
        transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) %>% # renormalize
        transform_sample_counts(function(x) {
          x[x < cutoff] <- 0
          x/sum(x)  # renormalize again so remaining abundances sum to 1
        })
  
    temp_counts <- psmelt(ps2plot) %>%
      filter(Abundance > 0) %>%
      group_by(Sample) %>%
      summarise(!!gsub("\\.", "p", paste0(cutoff * 100, "%")) := n())
  
  # Join to existing dataframe
  if (is.null(nonzero_per_sample)) {
    nonzero_per_sample <- temp_counts
  } else {
    nonzero_per_sample <- nonzero_per_sample %>%
      left_join(temp_counts, by = "Sample")
  }
}

nonzero_lf <- nonzero_per_sample %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Sample, 
               names_to = "cutoff", 
               values_to = "num_ASVs") %>% 
  left_join(samdf %>% rownames_to_column("Sample"), by = "Sample")

nonzero_lf <- set_ordered_factors(nonzero_lf)

summary_by_origin <- nonzero_lf %>%
  group_by(Sample_origin2, cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_ASVs = mean(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ASVs = sd(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ASVs = median(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ASVs = min(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ASVs = max(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Summary by Region and cutoff
summary_by_region <- nonzero_lf %>%
  group_by(Region, cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_ASVs = mean(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ASVs = sd(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ASVs = median(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ASVs = min(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ASVs = max(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

g <- ggplot(nonzero_lf, aes(x = num_ASVs, fill = Region)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Sample_origin2), cols = vars(cutoff)) +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),  # Legend text size
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Couple-Number-ASVs/Number-ASVs-region.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 4, height = 4)

for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_no)) {
  g <- ggplot(nonzero_lf %>% filter(sid == Subject_no), aes(x = num_ASVs, fill = Region)) + 
      geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(Sample_origin2), cols = vars(cutoff)) +
      theme_custom_text() +
      theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
            legend.text = element_text(size = 6),  # Legend text size
            legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))

      ggsave(paste0(directory, "Couple-Number-ASVs/Number-ASVs-region-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 4, height = 4)
}
```

```{r ASV fluctuations 0p01 cutoff plot features}
# Make all folders
for (sample_origin in c("Cap", "Saliva", "Stool")) {

  Subject = character(),
  Feature = character(),
  Mean = numeric(),
  Color = character(),
  Variance = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (sample_origin in c("Cap", "Saliva", "Stool")) {
  
  for (sid in c("Subj1", "Subj2")) {
    
    ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Subject_no == sid
                                     & group == "LONGIT"
                                     & Sample_origin2 == sample_origin
                                     & total_reads > 10000)
    
    stringent_taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
      filter(Abundance > stringent_cutoff)
    
    ps2plot <- ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # normalize (NO PRUNING)
    ps2plot <- prune_taxa(stringent_taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot)
    
    df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
    df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
    df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors
    
    # Plot all features in one figure
    
    g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = interaction(Collection_time, Collection_date_reformat, Region), y = Abundance, group = Feature)) +
      geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
      scale_y_log10(limits = c(1e-7, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +  # set y-axis limits
      geom_point(aes(fill = Diet_collection), size = 1, color = "black", shape = 21) +
      facet_wrap(~Feature, ncol = 12) +
      labs(x = "Collection time", y = "Abundance") +
      theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
            legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box)
      theme_custom_text() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
    
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-ASV-Fluctuation-0p01/", sid, "/ASV-fluctuation-", sid, "-", sample_origin, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 16, height = 8)
    
    # Individual features
    for (otu in unique(stringent_taxa2keep$Feature)) {
      df <- df2plot %>% filter(Feature == otu)
      
      g <- ggplot(df, aes(x = interaction(Sample_ID, Collection_time, Collection_date_reformat), y = Abundance, group = 1)) +
        geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
        scale_y_log10(limits = c(1e-7, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +  # set y-axis limits
        geom_point(aes(fill = Diet_collection), size = 1, color = "black", shape = 21) +
        labs(title = paste0(otu, ": ", unique(df$Taxon)), x = "Collection time", y = "Abundance") +
        theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
              axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1), 
              axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
              legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
              legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box) 
        theme_custom_text()
      
      ggsave(paste0(directory ,"/Couple-ASV-Fluctuation-0p01/", sid, "/", sample_origin, "/", sample_origin, "-", otu, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 0.1*n_distinct(df$Sample_ID), height = 2) 
      # Create a row and append it
      new_row <- data.frame(
        Subject = sid,
        Color = unique(df$Color),
        Feature = otu,
        Mean = mean(df$Abundance),
        Variance = var(df$Abundance),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        Sample_origin = sample_origin
      )
      ASV_fluctuation <- rbind(ASV_fluctuation, new_row)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r Calculate fluctuation variance}
all_slopes <- data.frame()

ASV_fluctuation <- ASV_fluctuation %>%
    mutate(Sample_origin = factor(Sample_origin, levels = c("Saliva", "Cap", "Stool")))
  
for (sid in c("Subj1", "Subj2")) {
  
  # Calculate slopes for each Sample_origin
  slopes <- ASV_fluctuation %>%
    filter(Subject == sid) %>%
    group_by(Sample_origin) %>%
    summarise(
      slope = coef(lm(log10(Variance) ~ log10(Mean)))[2],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Subject = sid,
           label = paste0("beta == ", round(slope, 2)))
 
  all_slopes <- bind_rows(all_slopes, slopes)

  g <- ggplot(ASV_fluctuation %>% filter(Subject == sid), aes(x = Mean, y = Variance)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Color), size = 2, shape = 21) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +  # add best-fit line
    scale_y_log10(labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(1e-4, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(Sample_origin)) +
    geom_text(data = slopes, aes(x = 5e-4, y = 5e-3, label = label), 
              hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "red", parse = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    labs(
      title = "Scatterplot of mean vs variance of each feature's relative abundance",
      x = "Mean relative abundance",
      y = "Relative abundance variance"
    ) +
    theme_custom_text() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-ASV-Fluctuation-0p01/Taylors-law/Mean-vs-var-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 3)
}
```

```{r Co-correlated ASVs - individual}

fdr_matrix <- function(pmat) {
  p <- pmat[upper.tri(pmat)]
  padj <- p.adjust(p, "fdr")
  
  out <- matrix(NA, nrow(pmat), ncol(pmat))
  out[upper.tri(out)] <- padj
  out <- t(out)
  out[upper.tri(out)] <- padj
  
  rownames(out) <- rownames(pmat)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(pmat)
  diag(out) <- NA
  out
}

cor_long <- data_frame()

for (sample_origin in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {

  for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_ID)) {
    
    ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Subject_ID == sid 
                                     & Sample_origin3 == sample_origin
                                     & total_reads > 10000)
    
    # Skip if not enough samples
    if (nsamples(ps2plot) <= 4) {
      message("Skipping ", sid, " - ", sample_origin, ": only ", nsamples(ps2plot), " samples")
      next
    }
    
    stringent_taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
        filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
    
    ps2plot <- ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # normalize (NO PRUNING)
    ps2plot <- prune_taxa(stringent_taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot)
    
    otu <- as(otu_table(ps2plot), "matrix")
    otu_clr <- clr(otu + 1e-7)
    res <- rcorr(otu_clr)
    
    p_adj_mat <- fdr_matrix(res$P)
    
    cor_mat <- res$r
    
    idx <- which(upper.tri(cor_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate number of real observations (not 1e-7 pseudocounts)
    n_real_obs <- apply(idx, 1, function(i) {
      f1 <- rownames(cor_mat)[i[1]]
      f2 <- colnames(cor_mat)[i[2]]
      # Count samples where both features are > 1e-7 (i.e., actually detected)
      sum(otu[, f1] > 1e-7 & otu[, f2] > 1e-7)
    })

    temp <- data.frame(
      feature1 = rownames(cor_mat)[idx[,1]],
      feature2 = colnames(cor_mat)[idx[,2]],
      r        = cor_mat[idx],
      fdr_p    = p_adj_mat[idx],
      n_obs    = n_real_obs,
      Subject_ID = sid,
      Sample_origin = sample_origin
    )
    
    cor_long <- rbind(cor_long, temp)
  }
}
```

```{r Co-correlated ASVs - across all subjects}
fdr_matrix <- function(pmat) {

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(total_reads > 10000)

stringent_taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
        filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)

df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors

cor_long <- data_frame()

for (sample_origin in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {
    
    ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin3 == sample_origin
                                     & total_reads > 10000)
    
    # Skip if not enough samples
    if (nsamples(ps2plot) <= 4) {
      message("Skipping ", sid, " - ", sample_origin, ": only ", nsamples(ps2plot), " samples")
      next
    }
    
    stringent_taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
        filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
    
    ps2plot <- ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # normalize (NO PRUNING)
    ps2plot <- prune_taxa(stringent_taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot)
    
    otu <- as(otu_table(ps2plot), "matrix")
    
    # Get sample metadata for subject tracking
    sample_meta <- sample_data(ps2plot) %>% 
      data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("Sample")
    
    otu_clr <- clr(otu + 1e-7)
    res <- rcorr(otu_clr)
    
    p_adj_mat <- fdr_matrix(res$P)
    
    cor_mat <- res$r
    
    idx <- which(upper.tri(cor_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate number of real observations (not 1e-7 pseudocounts)
    n_real_obs <- apply(idx, 1, function(i) {
      f1 <- rownames(cor_mat)[i[1]]
      f2 <- colnames(cor_mat)[i[2]]
      # Count samples where both features are > 1e-7 (i.e., actually detected)
      sum(otu[, f1] > 1e-7 & otu[, f2] > 1e-7)
    })
    
    # Calculate number of subjects
    n_subjects <- apply(idx, 1, function(i) {
      f1 <- rownames(cor_mat)[i[1]]
      f2 <- colnames(cor_mat)[i[2]]
      # Get samples where both features detected
      samples_with_both <- rownames(otu)[otu[, f1] > 1e-7 & otu[, f2] > 1e-7]
      # Count unique subjects
      n_distinct(sample_meta$Subject_ID[sample_meta$Sample %in% samples_with_both])
    })

    temp <- data.frame(
      feature1 = rownames(cor_mat)[idx[,1]],
      feature2 = colnames(cor_mat)[idx[,2]],
      r        = cor_mat[idx],
      fdr_p    = p_adj_mat[idx],
      n_obs    = n_real_obs,
      n_subj   = n_subjects,
      Sample_origin = sample_origin
    )
    
    cor_long <- rbind(cor_long, temp)
}
```

```{r starvation - composition}
  df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors
  
  df2plot <- df2plot %>%
  mutate(Revival = recode(Revival,
                          "Yes" = "Revived",
                          "No" = "Starved",
                          "NA" = "Input"),
         Revival = factor(Revival, levels = c("Input", "Starved", "Revived")))
```
  
```{r starvation - ASV heatmap - by sample_origin}
    g <- ggplot(df2plot) +
       geom_tile(aes(x = interaction(total_reads, Revival), y = interaction(Feature, Taxon), fill = log10(Abundance))) +
       scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", na.value = "black", limits = c(-3, 0)) +
       facet_nested(cols = vars(Diet_ingestion, Diet_collection, Collection_date_reformat, Collection_time, Kit_ID, Sample_origin2, Region), space = "free", scales = "free") +
       theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(),
             axis.title.x = element_blank(),
             axis.title.y = element_blank(),
             axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
             axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
             axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
             aspect.ratio = 1) +
       theme_custom_text()
    
     ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Starvation/ASV-heatmap-0p01-capscan-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 0.15*(length(unique(df2plot$Feature))+3))
}
```

```{r starvation - pcoa}

starvation <- samdf %>% filter(group == "Starvation") %>% select(Sample_ID)

set.seed(100) # Consistent pcoa

ps2ordinate <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_ID %in% starvation$Sample_ID
                                   & total_reads > 5000
                                   & Sample_ID != "BHIS") # Choose which samples you want to ordinate

otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)

otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ] # Remove rows with all zeros (empty OTU rows)
otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ] # Remove OTUs present in < 3 samples
    
retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)
    
# Subset all components accordingly
ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
                           sample_data(ps),
                           tax_table(ps)[retained_otus, ],
                           phy_tree(ps))
    
ps_clean <- prune_taxa(retained_otus, ps_clean)
    
for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {
    
      pcoa_weighted <- ordinate(ps_clean, method = "MDS", distance = d_metric)
      ordination_data <- merge(pcoa_weighted$vectors, samdf, by = "row.names")
      var_exp <- get_evals(pcoa_weighted)$variance_exp # variances
  
      x_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.1)
      y_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.2)
      aspect_ratio <- diff(x_range) / diff(y_range)
      
      ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data) # set ordered factors
      
      ordination_data <- ordination_data %>%
          mutate(Revival = recode(Revival,
                          "Yes" = "Revived",
                          "No" = "Starved",
                          "NA" = "Input"),
         Revival = factor(Revival, levels = c("Input", "Starved", "Revived"))) %>%
         arrange(Sample_ID, Revival)
      
      # lines_df <- ordination_data %>%
      #   filter(Region %in% region_order) %>%
      #   mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = region_order)) %>%
      #   arrange(Kit_ID, Region)  # Ensures correct order within Kit_ID
      
      colors2plot <- turbo(length(unique(ordination_data$Sample_ID)), begin = 0.05, end = 0.95, direction = -1) # Define colors
      
       g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Sample_ID, shape = Revival)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           geom_line(aes(group = Sample_ID), color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("Input" = 21, "Starved" = 22, "Revived" = 23)) +
           guides(fill = "none") +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                           cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                           TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes
         # theme(legend.position = "null")
      
      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Starvation/PCoA/PCoA-", d_metric, "-all.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 3)
      
      g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Sample_ID, shape = Revival)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           geom_line(aes(group = Sample_ID), color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +
           facet_grid(cols = vars(Subject_no)) +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("Input" = 21, "Starved" = 22, "Revived" = 23)) +
           guides(fill = "none") +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                           cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                           TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio) # Force square axes
        #  theme(legend.position = "null")
      
      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Starvation/PCoA/Subject_no/PCoA-", d_metric, "-all.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 8, height = 3)
      
      g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Sample_ID, shape = Revival)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           geom_line(aes(group = Sample_ID), color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +
           facet_wrap(vars(Sample_ID)) +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("Input" = 21, "Starved" = 22, "Revived" = 23)) +
           guides(fill = "none") +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(3, 3, 3, 3), "cm"), 
                           cols = unit(c(3, 3, 3, 3), "cm"), 
                           TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes
        #  theme(legend.position = "null")
      
      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Starvation/PCoA/Sample_ID/PCoA-", d_metric, "-all.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 16, height = 12)
    
}
```

```{r Capscan - merge by capsule and show how it merges}
  data.frame() %>%
  group_by(Capscan_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r pcoa all metrics BOTH}
set.seed(100) # Consistent PCoA

# Define constants
DISTANCE_METRICS <- c("binary", "bray", "canberra", "unifrac", "wunifrac")
WINDOW_SIZES <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
SHAPE_MAPPING <- c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)

# Helper function to create variance explained labels
create_var_labels <- function(var_exp_df) {
  geom_text(
    data = var_exp_df, 
    aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("PCo1: ", PCo1_var, "%\nPCo2: ", PCo2_var, "%")),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
}

# Main loop
for (sid in c("Subj1", "Subj2")) {
  
  # Subset and clean phyloseq object
  ps2ordinate <- ps %>% 
    subset_samples(group == "LONGIT" &
                  Subject_no == sid &
                  ((Sample_origin2 == "Cap" & Ingestion_week %in% 1:6) | 
                   (Sample_origin == "Stool" & Collection_week %in% 1:6)) &
                  total_reads > 10000)
  
  # Clean OTU table
  otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)
  otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ]
  otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ]
  retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)
  
  # Reconstruct phyloseq object
  ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
                            sample_data(ps),
                            tax_table(ps)[retained_otus, ],
                            phy_tree(ps)) %>%
              prune_taxa(retained_otus, .)
  
  # Perform ordinations for all distance metrics
  all_ordination_data <- list()
  all_centroid_data <- list()
  var_exp_list <- list()
  
  for (d_metric in DISTANCE_METRICS) {
    
    # PCoA ordination
    pcoa_weighted <- ordinate(ps_clean, method = "MDS", distance = d_metric)
    ordination_data <- merge(pcoa_weighted$vectors, samdf, by = "row.names")
    var_exp <- get_evals(pcoa_weighted)$variance_exp
    
    # Add metric and set factor levels
    ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data)
    ordination_data$d_metric <- d_metric
    
    # Store variance explained
    var_exp_list[[d_metric]] <- data.frame(d_metric = d_metric,
                                          PCo1_var = round(var_exp[1], 2),
                                          PCo2_var = round(var_exp[2], 2))
    
    # Calculate centroids per kit
    centroid_per_kit <- ordination_data %>%
      group_by(Kit_ID, Diet_ingestion, Diet_collection, Subject_no, 
               Sample_origin, Sample_origin2, d_metric) %>%
      summarise(
        centroid_x = mean(Axis.1, na.rm = TRUE),
        centroid_y = mean(Axis.2, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
    
    all_ordination_data[[d_metric]] <- ordination_data
    all_centroid_data[[d_metric]] <- centroid_per_kit
  }
  
  # Combine all data
  combined_ordination <- bind_rows(all_ordination_data) %>%
    mutate(d_metric = factor(d_metric, levels = DISTANCE_METRICS))
  
  combined_centroids <- bind_rows(all_centroid_data) %>%
    mutate(d_metric = factor(d_metric, levels = DISTANCE_METRICS))
  
  var_exp_df <- bind_rows(var_exp_list)
  
  # Plot 1: All samples - Capsule
  g_cap_all <- ggplot(
    combined_ordination %>% filter(Sample_origin2 == "Cap"), 
    aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Diet_ingestion, shape = Region)
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = SHAPE_MAPPING) +
    geom_polygon(aes(group = Kit_ID), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, 
                 show.legend = FALSE, linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_point(stroke = 0.2, color = "black") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
    base_theme
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/Rolling-window/Both/PCoA-", sid, "-BOTH-cap-ingestion-diet-kit.pdf"), 
    plot = g_cap_all, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 4)
  
  # Plot 2: Centroids - Capsule
  g_cap_cent <- ggplot(combined_centroids %>% filter(Sample_origin2 == "Cap"), 
                       aes(x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y, fill = Diet_ingestion)) +
                scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
                geom_path(aes(group = Subject_no), color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.4, lineend = "round") +
                geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.2, color = "black") +
                facet_grid(cols = vars(d_metric)) +
                create_var_labels(var_exp_df) +
                labs(x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2") +
                theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
                theme_custom_text() 
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/Rolling-window/Both/PCoA-", sid, "-BOTH-cap-ingestion-diet-kit-centroid.pdf"), 
    plot = g_cap_cent, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 3)
  
  # Plot 2: Centroids - Stool
  g_stool_cent <- ggplot(combined_centroids %>% filter(Sample_origin2 == "Stool"), 
                         aes(x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y, fill = Diet_collection)) +
                  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
                  geom_path(aes(group = Subject_no), color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.4, lineend = "round") +
                  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.2, color = "black") +
                  facet_grid(cols = vars(d_metric)) +
                  create_var_labels(var_exp_df) +
                  labs(x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2") +
                  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
                  theme_custom_text() 
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/Rolling-window/Both/PCoA-", sid, "-BOTH-stool-collection-diet-kit-centroid.pdf"), 
    plot = g_stool_cent, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 3)
  
  # Rolling window analysis - Combined plots
  # Capsule rolling centroids - all window sizes
  all_running_centroids_cap <- map_dfr(WINDOW_SIZES, function(wsize) {
    calculate_rolling_centroids(combined_ordination %>% filter(Sample_origin2 == "Cap"), 
                                window_size = wsize,
                                sample_origin = "Cap") %>%
      mutate(window_size = wsize)})

  g_cap_roll_combined <- ggplot(all_running_centroids_cap, 
                                aes(x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y, fill = Diet_ingestion)) +
                         scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
                         scale_color_manual(values = colors_diet) +
                         geom_path(aes(group = interaction(Subject_no, d_metric), color = Diet_ingestion), 
                                   linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
                         geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1.5, stroke = 0.3, color = "black") +
                         geom_text(aes(label = paste0(window_start, "-", window_end)), 
                                   size = 1.5, nudge_y = 0.01, check_overlap = TRUE) +
                         create_var_labels(var_exp_df) +
                         labs(x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2", 
                              title = paste0(sid, " - Capsule Rolling Window Centroids")) +
                         theme_custom_text() +
                         facet_grid(rows = vars(window_size), cols = vars(d_metric),
                                    labeller = labeller(window_size = function(x) paste0("Window: ", x, " days"))) +
                         theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/Rolling-window/Both/PCoA-", sid, "-BOTH-cap-ingestion-diet-days.pdf"), 
                plot = g_cap_roll_combined, device = "pdf", 
                width = 14, height = 12)

  # Stool rolling centroids - all window sizes
  all_running_centroids_stool <- map_dfr(WINDOW_SIZES, function(wsize) {
    calculate_rolling_centroids(combined_ordination %>% filter(Sample_origin2 == "Stool"), 
                                window_size = wsize,
                                sample_origin = "Stool") %>%
                                   mutate(window_size = wsize)})

  g_stool_roll_combined <- ggplot(all_running_centroids_stool, 
                           aes(x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y, fill = Diet_collection)) +
                           scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
                           scale_color_manual(values = colors_diet) +
                           geom_path(aes(group = interaction(Subject_no, d_metric), color = Diet_collection), 
                                     linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
                           geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1.5, stroke = 0.3, color = "black") +
                           geom_text(aes(label = paste0(window_start, "-", window_end)), 
                                     size = 1.5, nudge_y = 0.01, check_overlap = TRUE) +
                           create_var_labels(var_exp_df) +
                           labs(x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2", 
                                title = paste0(sid, " - Stool Rolling Window Centroids")) +
                           theme_custom_text() +
                           facet_grid(rows = vars(window_size), cols = vars(d_metric),
                                      labeller = labeller(window_size = function(x) paste0("Window: ", x, " days"))) +
                           theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/Rolling-window/Both/PCoA-", sid, "-BOTH-stool-collection-diet-days.pdf"), 
    plot = g_stool_roll_combined, device = "pdf", 
    width = 14, height = 12)
```

```{r PCoA exploration - BOTH}

set.seed(100) # Consistent pcoa

for (sid in c("Subj1", "Subj2")) {
    
    ps2ordinate <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin2 == "Cap" 
                                         & group == "LONGIT"
                                         & Subject_no == sid
                                         & Ingestion_week %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")
                                         & total_reads > 10000) # Choose which samples you want to ordinate
    otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)
    
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ] # Remove rows with all zeros (empty OTU rows)
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ] # Remove OTUs present in < 3 samples
    
    retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)
    
    # Subset all components accordingly
    ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
                               sample_data(ps),
                               tax_table(ps)[retained_otus, ],
                               phy_tree(ps))
    
    ps_clean <- prune_taxa(retained_otus, ps_clean)
    
    for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {
    
      pcoa_weighted <- ordinate(ps_clean, method = "MDS", distance = d_metric)
      ordination_data <- merge(pcoa_weighted$vectors, samdf, by = "row.names")
      var_exp <- get_evals(pcoa_weighted)$variance_exp # variances
  
      x_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.1)
      y_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.2)
      aspect_ratio <- diff(x_range) / diff(y_range)
      
      ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data) # set ordered factors
      
      lines_df <- ordination_data %>%
        filter(Region %in% region_order) %>%
        mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = region_order)) %>%
        arrange(Sample_ID, Region)  # Ensures correct order within Kit_ID
      
      colors2plot <- colors_diet
     
      g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Diet_ingestion, shape = Region)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
           geom_polygon(aes(group = Kit_ID, fill = Diet_ingestion), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
           guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
           #facet_wrap(~Kit_ID, ncol = 5) +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes

      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/", sid, "/Cap/PCoA-", d_metric, "-", sid, "-", "capscan-ingestion-diet.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 7)
      
       g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Diet_ingestion, shape = Region)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
           geom_polygon(aes(group = Kit_ID, fill = Diet_ingestion), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
           guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
           facet_wrap(~Kit_ID, ncol = 8) +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "cm"), TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes

      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/", sid, "/Cap/PCoA-", d_metric, "-", sid, "-", "capscan-ingestion-diet-kit.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 8)
    
      centroid_per_kit <- ordination_data %>%
        group_by(Kit_ID, Diet_ingestion, Subject_no) %>%
        summarise(centroid_x = mean(Axis.1, na.rm = TRUE),
                  centroid_y = mean(Axis.2, na.rm = TRUE),
                  .groups = 'drop')
      
      g <- ggplot(centroid_per_kit, aes(x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y, fill = Diet_ingestion)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +  # Assuming you have this defined
           geom_path(aes(group = Subject_no), color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.6, lineend = "round") +
           geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           facet_wrap(~Subject_no, ncol = 5) +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), TRUE) +
           labs(title = paste0(d_metric, "-centroid-kit"),
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)
      
      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/", sid, "/Cap/PCoA-", d_metric, "-", sid, "-", "capscan-ingestion-diet-centroid.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 8)
      
    }
}
```

```{r pcoa all metrics cap}
set.seed(100) # Consistent pcoa

for (sid in c("Subj1", "Subj2")) {
    
    ps2ordinate <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin2 == "Cap" 
                                         & group == "LONGIT"
                                         & Subject_no == sid
                                         & Ingestion_week %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")
                                         & total_reads > 10000)
    otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)
    
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ]
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ]
    
    retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)
    
    ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
                               sample_data(ps),
                               tax_table(ps)[retained_otus, ],
                               phy_tree(ps))
    
    ps_clean <- prune_taxa(retained_otus, ps_clean)
    
    # Initialize list to store all ordination data
    all_ordination_data <- list()
    all_centroid_data <- list()
    var_exp_list <- list()
    
    for (d_metric in c("bray", "binary", "canberra", "unifrac", "wunifrac")) {
    
      pcoa_weighted <- ordinate(ps_clean, method = "MDS", distance = d_metric)
      ordination_data <- merge(pcoa_weighted$vectors, samdf, by = "row.names")
      var_exp <- get_evals(pcoa_weighted)$variance_exp
      
      ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data)
      ordination_data$d_metric <- d_metric  # Add metric column
      
      # Store variance explained
      var_exp_list[[d_metric]] <- data.frame(
        d_metric = d_metric,
        PCo1_var = round(var_exp[1], 2),
        PCo2_var = round(var_exp[2], 2)
      )
      
      # Calculate centroids
      centroid_per_kit <- ordination_data %>%
        group_by(Kit_ID, Diet_ingestion, Subject_no, d_metric) %>%
        summarise(centroid_x = mean(Axis.1, na.rm = TRUE),
                  centroid_y = mean(Axis.2, na.rm = TRUE),
                  .groups = 'drop')
      
      all_ordination_data[[d_metric]] <- ordination_data
      all_centroid_data[[d_metric]] <- centroid_per_kit
    }
    
    # Combine all data
    combined_ordination <- bind_rows(all_ordination_data)
    combined_centroids <- bind_rows(all_centroid_data)
    var_exp_df <- bind_rows(var_exp_list)
    
    # Create factor with proper ordering
    combined_ordination$d_metric <- factor(combined_ordination$d_metric, 
                                           levels = c("binary", "bray", "canberra", "unifrac", "wunifrac"))
    combined_centroids$d_metric <- factor(combined_centroids$d_metric, 
                                         levels = c("binary", "bray", "canberra", "unifrac", "wunifrac"))
    
    colors2plot <- colors_diet
    
    # Plot 1: All samples, no faceting by Kit
    g <- ggplot(combined_ordination, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Diet_ingestion, shape = Region)) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
         geom_polygon(aes(group = Kit_ID, fill = Diet_ingestion), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE, linewidth = 0.2) +
         geom_point(stroke = 0.2, color = "black") +
         scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
         guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
         facet_grid(cols = vars(d_metric), scales = "free") +
         force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"), TRUE) +
         geom_text(data = var_exp_df, 
                   aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("PCo1: ", PCo1_var, "%\nPCo2: ", PCo2_var, "%")),
                   hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
         labs(x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2") +
         theme_custom_text()

    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/PCoA-all-metrics-", sid, "-capscan-ingestion-diet.pdf"), 
           plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 4)
    
    # Plot 2: Centroids
    g <- ggplot(combined_centroids, aes(x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y, fill = Diet_ingestion)) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
         geom_path(aes(group = Subject_no), color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.4, lineend = "round") +
         geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.2, color = "black") +
         facet_grid(cols = vars(d_metric), scales = "free") +
         force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"), TRUE) +
         geom_text(data = var_exp_df, 
                   aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("PCo1: ", PCo1_var, "%\nPCo2: ", PCo2_var, "%")),
                   hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
         labs(x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2") +
         theme_custom_text()
    
     ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/PCoA-all-metrics-", sid, "-capscan-ingestion-diet-centroid.pdf"), 
           plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 3)
     
     ## Running windows

    window_sizes = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)

    for (wsize in window_sizes) {
      running_centroids <- calculate_rolling_centroids(combined_ordination, window_size = wsize, sample_origin = "Cap")
    
    g <- ggplot(running_centroids, aes(x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y, fill = Diet_ingestion)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
      geom_path(aes(group = Subject_no, color = Diet_ingestion), linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
      facet_grid(cols = vars(d_metric), scales = "free") +
      force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"), TRUE) +
      geom_text(aes(label = paste0(window_start, "-", window_end)), 
                size = 2, nudge_y = 0.01, check_overlap = TRUE) +
      scale_color_manual(values = colors_diet) +
      
      labs(title = paste0(sid, " - Running ", wsize, "-Day centroids"), x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2") +
      theme_custom_text()
    
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/Rolling-window/", sid, "-capscan-ingestion-diet-centroid-window-size-", wsize, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 3)

}
}
```

```{r pcoa all metrics stool}
set.seed(100) # Consistent pcoa

for (sid in c("Subj1", "Subj2")) {
    
    ps2ordinate <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin2 == "Stool" 
                                         & group == "LONGIT"
                                         & Subject_no == sid
                                         & Collection_week %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")
                                         & total_reads > 10000)
    otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)
    
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ]
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ]
    
    retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)
    
    ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
                               sample_data(ps),
                               tax_table(ps)[retained_otus, ],
                               phy_tree(ps))
    
    ps_clean <- prune_taxa(retained_otus, ps_clean)
    
    # Initialize list to store all ordination data
    all_ordination_data <- list()
    all_centroid_data <- list()
    var_exp_list <- list()
    
    for (d_metric in c("binary", "bray", "canberra", "unifrac", "wunifrac")) {
    
      pcoa_weighted <- ordinate(ps_clean, method = "MDS", distance = d_metric)
      ordination_data <- merge(pcoa_weighted$vectors, samdf, by = "row.names")
      var_exp <- get_evals(pcoa_weighted)$variance_exp
      
      ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data)
      ordination_data$d_metric <- d_metric  # Add metric column
      
      # Store variance explained
      var_exp_list[[d_metric]] <- data.frame(
        d_metric = d_metric,
        PCo1_var = round(var_exp[1], 2),
        PCo2_var = round(var_exp[2], 2)
      )
      
      # Calculate centroids
      centroid_per_kit <- ordination_data %>%
        group_by(Kit_ID, Diet_collection, Subject_no, d_metric) %>%
        summarise(centroid_x = mean(Axis.1, na.rm = TRUE),
                  centroid_y = mean(Axis.2, na.rm = TRUE),
                  .groups = 'drop')
      
      all_ordination_data[[d_metric]] <- ordination_data
      all_centroid_data[[d_metric]] <- centroid_per_kit
    }
    
    # Combine all data
    combined_ordination <- bind_rows(all_ordination_data)
    combined_centroids <- bind_rows(all_centroid_data)
    var_exp_df <- bind_rows(var_exp_list)
    
    # Create factor with proper ordering
        combined_ordination$d_metric <- factor(combined_ordination$d_metric, 
                                           levels = c("binary", "bray", "canberra", "unifrac", "wunifrac"))
    combined_centroids$d_metric <- factor(combined_centroids$d_metric, 
                                         levels = c("binary", "bray", "canberra", "unifrac", "wunifrac"))
    colors2plot <- colors_diet
    
    # Plot 1: All samples, no faceting by Kit
    g <- ggplot(combined_ordination, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Diet_collection, shape = Region)) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
         geom_polygon(aes(group = Kit_ID, fill = Diet_collection), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE, linewidth = 0.2) +
         geom_point(stroke = 0.2, color = "black") +
         scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
         guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
         facet_grid(cols = vars(d_metric), scales = "free") +
         force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"), TRUE) +
         geom_text(data = var_exp_df, 
                   aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("PCo1: ", PCo1_var, "%\nPCo2: ", PCo2_var, "%")),
                   hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
         labs(x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2") +
         theme_custom_text()

    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/PCoA-all-metrics-", sid, "-stool-collection-diet.pdf"), 
           plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 4)
    
    # Plot 2: Centroids
    g <- ggplot(combined_centroids, aes(x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y, fill = Diet_collection)) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
         geom_path(aes(group = Subject_no), color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.4, lineend = "round") +
         geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.2, color = "black") +
         facet_grid(cols = vars(d_metric), scales = "free") +
         force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"), TRUE) +
         geom_text(data = var_exp_df, 
                   aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("PCo1: ", PCo1_var, "%\nPCo2: ", PCo2_var, "%")),
                   hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
         labs(x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2") +
         theme_custom_text()
    
     ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/PCoA-all-metrics-", sid, "-stool-collection-diet-centroid.pdf"), 
           plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 3)
     
     # Rolling window
     window_sizes = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)

    for (wsize in window_sizes) {
      running_centroids <- calculate_rolling_centroids(combined_ordination, window_size = wsize, sample_origin = "Stool")
    
    g <- ggplot(running_centroids, aes(x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y, fill = Diet_collection)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors_diet) +
      geom_path(aes(group = Subject_no, color = Diet_collection), linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
      facet_grid(cols = vars(d_metric), scales = "free") +
      force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "cm"), TRUE) +
      geom_text(aes(label = paste0(window_start, "-", window_end)), 
                size = 2, nudge_y = 0.01, check_overlap = TRUE) +
      scale_color_manual(values = colors_diet) +
      
      labs(title = paste0(sid, " - Running ", wsize, "-Day centroids"), x = "PCo1", y = "PCo2") +
      theme_custom_text()
    
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/Rolling-window/", sid, "-stool-collection-diet-centroid-window-size-", wsize, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 3)

  }

}
```

```{r PCoA exploration - stool}

set.seed(100) # Consistent pcoa

for (sid in c("Subj1", "Subj2")) {
    
    ps2ordinate <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin2 == "Stool" 
                                         & group == "LONGIT"
                                         & Subject_no == sid
                                         & Collection_week %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")
                                         & total_reads > 10000) # Choose which samples you want to ordinate
    
    otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)
    
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ] # Remove rows with all zeros (empty OTU rows)
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ] # Remove OTUs present in < 3 samples
    
    retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)
    
    # Subset all components accordingly
    ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
                               sample_data(ps),
                               tax_table(ps)[retained_otus, ],
                               phy_tree(ps))
    
    ps_clean <- prune_taxa(retained_otus, ps_clean)
    
    for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {
    
      pcoa_weighted <- ordinate(ps_clean, method = "MDS", distance = d_metric)
      ordination_data <- merge(pcoa_weighted$vectors, samdf, by = "row.names")
      var_exp <- get_evals(pcoa_weighted)$variance_exp # variances
  
      x_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.1)
      y_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.2)
      aspect_ratio <- diff(x_range) / diff(y_range)
      
      ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data) # set ordered factors
      
      lines_df <- ordination_data %>%
        filter(Region %in% region_order) %>%
        mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = region_order)) %>%
        arrange(Sample_ID, Region)  # Ensures correct order within Kit_ID
      
      colors2plot <- colors_diet
     
      g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Diet_collection, shape = Region)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
           geom_polygon(aes(group = Collection_date_reformat, fill = Diet_collection), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
           guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
           #facet_wrap(~Kit_ID, ncol = 5) +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes

      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/", sid, "/Stool/PCoA-", d_metric, "-", sid, "-", "stool-collection-diet.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 7)
      
       g <- ggplot(ordination_data, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, fill = Diet_collection, shape = Region)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = colors2plot) +
           geom_polygon(aes(group = Collection_date_reformat, fill = Diet_collection), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
           geom_point(stroke = 0.5, color = "black") +
           scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
           guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + # Fill legend
           facet_wrap(~Collection_date_reformat, ncol = 8) +
           force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "cm"),
                           cols = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "cm"), TRUE) +
           labs(title = d_metric,
                x = paste0("PCo1 ", round(var_exp[1],2), "%"),
                y = paste0("PCo2 ", round(var_exp[2],2), "%")) +
           coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio)  # Force square axes

      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/", sid, "/Stool/PCoA-", d_metric, "-", sid, "-", "stool-collection-diet-collection-date.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 8)
  
      
    }
}
```

```{r FAVA stool}
)

   ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/FAVA/Stool-collection-wsize-", wsize, "-similarity-matrix.pdf"), plot = window_out$window_plot, device = "pdf", width = 7, height = 4)

    start = w1, # Add start column (value of w1)
```

```{r FAVA average capscan}
      group == 2 ~ "Subj2"), # Remap group: 1 -> Subj1, 2 -> Subj2

    start = w1, # Add start column (value of w1)
    
    # Add end column based on window_size
    end = case_when(
      window_size == 2 ~ w2,
      window_size == 3 ~ w3,
      window_size == 4 ~ w4,
      window_size == 5 ~ w5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # In case there are other window sizes
    )
  )

g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = start, xend = end, y = FAVA, yend = FAVA)) +
  geom_segment(linewidth = 0.2, color = "black") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(window_size), cols = vars(group)) +
  labs(x = "Timeline (days)", 
       y = "FAVA", 
       title = "FAVA values across rolling windows") +
  theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/FAVA/Cap-ingestion.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 8, height = 4)
```

```{r Z-score ASV fluctuation}
for (sid in c("Subj1", "Subj2")){
  
  ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(group == "LONGIT"
                                 & Sample_origin2 == "Cap"
                                 & total_reads > 10000
                                 & Ingestion_week %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")
                                 & Subject_no == sid)

  taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
      filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
    
  ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
      transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize
    
  # Get relative abundance data
  ps_melt <- psmelt(ps2plot)
  ps_melt <- set_ordered_factors(ps_melt)

  # Add pseudocount and log-transform
  pseudocount <- 1e-7
  
  ps_melt <- ps_melt %>%
    mutate(log_abundance = log10(Abundance + pseudocount))
  
  # Calculate mean and SD from Regular1/Regular2 samples for each ASV (on log scale)
  baseline_stats <- ps_melt %>%
    filter(Diet_ingestion %in% c("Regular1", "Regular2")) %>%
    group_by(OTU) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_log_abundance = mean(log_abundance),
      sd_log_abundance = sd(log_abundance),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Join stats back to full dataset and calculate z-scores
  ps_zscore <- ps_melt %>% 
    left_join(baseline_stats, by = "OTU") %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate z-score on log scale
      z_score = ifelse(sd_log_abundance == 0 | is.na(sd_log_abundance),
                       (log_abundance - mean_log_abundance) / 0.1,  # Handle cases where SD = 0
                       (log_abundance - mean_log_abundance) / sd_log_abundance)
    ) %>%
    mutate(significant = abs(z_score) >= 2)
  
  # Create heatmap
  g <- ggplot(ps_zscore, aes(x = interaction(Region, Capscan_ID, Ingestion_time, Ingestion_date_reformat), 
                                          y = interaction(Feature, Taxon), fill = z_score)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(data = subset(ps_zscore, significant),
            aes(label = "*"),  
            color = "white", 
            size = 3,
            vjust = 0.75) +  # Adjust vertical position if needed
    facet_grid(cols = vars(Diet_ingestion), space = "free", scales = "free") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", 
                         midpoint = 0, name = "Z-score",
                         limits = c(-4, 4), oob = scales::squish) +  # Cap extreme values
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)) +
    labs(x = "Sample", y = "Feature", 
         title = "Z-scores of Log10 ASV Relative Abundance (capped at +/- 4)") +
    theme_custom_text()
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PCoA-exploration/Z-score/", sid, "-cap-ingestion.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 10)
}
```
